title: A three-dimensional typology of agency for advanced AI systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.20041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on the agency of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) systems focuses on agency as a normative concept and on the agency of particularly agentic AI systems. While recent work also focuses on the different profiles of agentic systems, no framework exists to address the question of the type of agency instantiated by advanced AI systems, particularly when considering non-moral forms of agency. Based on established theoretical positions in philosophy, ethics, legal theory and sociology, we develop a typology of agency for frontier AI systems consisting of three dimensions: the nature of agency (moral or legal), its mode (individual or collective) and its locus (human or non-human). Combining these dimensions produces eight possible instantiations of agency, which we classify as conventional, contested or controversial. translated_title: 高级人工智能系统能动性的三维类型学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20041v1 公告类型：新 摘要：关于高级人工智能（AI）系统能动性的研究，主要关注能动性作为规范性概念，以及特别具有能动性的AI系统的能动性。尽管近期工作也关注能动性系统的不同特征，但尚无框架来解决高级AI系统所体现的能动性类型问题，尤其是在考虑非道德形式的能动性时。基于哲学、伦理学、法律理论和社会学中既定的理论立场，我们为前沿AI系统开发了一种能动性类型学，包含三个维度：能动性的本质（道德或法律）、其模式（个体或集体）以及其所在（人类或非人类）。组合这些维度产生了八种可能的能动性体现，我们将其分类为传统、争议性或争议性。该类型学将法律能动性与道德能动性分离，从而为考虑个体、法律能动性创造了概念空间。
tldr: 本文提出了一种三维类型学框架，用于分类高级AI系统的能动性，区分道德与法律、个体与集体、人类与非人类维度，并识别八种可能的能动性体现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-dimensional typology framework to classify the agency of advanced AI systems, distinguishing moral from legal, individual from collective, and human from non-human dimensions, and identifying eight possible instantiations of agency.
